newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HANSA ASSET OPENS LATVIA OFFICE, TO LAUNCH FUND.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HANSA ASSET OPENS LATVIA OFFICE, TO LAUNCH FUND.

text.p: Hansa Asset Management said on Monday it has opened a Riga office and will apply to register an open-ended investment fund in Latvia in the coming week.
It also said that it has plans for Lithuania in the longer-term.
Hansa Asset opened its Latvian subsidiary, Hansa Asset Management-Latvija, at the end of April, Raul Malmstein, director of Hansa Asset Management, told Reuters.
"In summer, there will be Hansa Asset Management-Lithuania as well," Malmstein added.
"We plan to launch an open-end investment fund in Latvia, which are very popular in Estonia already," he said.
Hansa Asset Management, part of Hansapank , manages the Baltic Growth Fund, the Hansa Privatisation Fund, listed on Tallinn Stock Exchange, and the Hansa Money market fund.
"Latvia has a lot of capital, which is seeking the best for investment opportunities...while Lithuania has a huge potential to get new clients," Malmstein said.
The Latvian market was also interesting due to the forthcoming sale of state infrastructure companies, in which the new fund will participate, Malmstein said.
He added that Hansa Asset Management will also make use of its presence in all Baltic countries to get information on the market sitution.
Malmstein said the disadvantage of the Latvian market was that most potential clients do not know about open-end investment funds.
Malmstein said it is hard to make any concrete estimates for the Latvian fund.
"The potential is good, although interest will be higher from local corporate clients and foreign investors at the start compared to modest interest from individuals," he said.
"The question is in reliability and we hope to break the barrier relatively quickly," he said.
